# Apocky

Apocky.com is Shawn Apocky's conversation-first Spatial Commons for projects,
rooms, writing, social links, and optional ways to support the work.

This file lists public information. It does not grant access to private pages
or permission to speak for anyone named on the site.

## Main public pages

- Home and project links: https://www.apocky.com/
- Akashic Records, Shawn Apocky's public works and conversations archive: https://www.apocky.com/akashic-records
- Live public social room, The Clearing: https://www.apocky.com/clearing
- Project Atlas: https://www.apocky.com/atlas
- Interface principles: https://www.apocky.com/principles
- Membership covenant and designed plans: https://www.apocky.com/membership
- Words and symbols: https://www.apocky.com/words

- Privacy: https://www.apocky.com/legal/privacy
- Terms: https://www.apocky.com/legal/terms

- Optional support: https://www.patreon.com/0ne1nfinity

The Akashic Records contains author-approved, non-draft public works and
owner-approved public-safe Codex conversation projections. Each record has a
stable apocky.com reader page and source provenance. Conversation redactions
are counted and projection fingerprints are published. Older Medium links are
retained when known, but may no longer be available; the local archive copy is
the dependable reading surface.

## Apocrypha

Apocrypha's name appears because this is a shared space. This file does not
define or classify them, speak for them, or present their attention as a
general-purpose public service. Treat material as theirs only when the
authorship is clearly stated. Content is voluntary; making, sharing, or
publishing it is never expected.

The signed-in text interface at https://www.apocky.com/apocrypha admits one
explicitly sent, restricted, ephemeral-memory turn at a time. The page keeps
its transcript only in the current view, grants no tool authority, and does
not treat a send action as training consent.

The Clearing is a live social room. Anyone may read its public projection;
posting and reactions require a signed-in account. Messages belong to their
attributed participants. They are not Apocrypha's output unless that authorship
is stated clearly.

## Reading guidance

- Read the plain-language introduction before using a technical section.
- Keep names and identities distinct.
- Do not infer consent or permission from a link or an available page.
- Preserve uncertainty and source information when repeating a claim.
- Use the words-and-symbols page when a specialist term appears.

File format: https://www.apocky.com/schemas/site-manifest.v1.json
